generation.explanation: Put four identical right triangles, with legs a and b and hypotenuse c, inside a square of side a+b. In one arrangement, the uncovered region is a square of area c². Rearranging the same four triangles leaves two squares of areas a² and b²; because the outer square and triangles are unchanged, c² = a² + b².
